category_title: Autistic students who partially process problems with discrepancy gestures and echolalia
scenario_title: Identifying shapes triggering echolalia and spatial marking
minimal_context: Rico is working on a task sheet to identify tube shapes among images of concrete objects like a piggy bank and a ball.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please look at the task sheet and find the tube shape.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Moves his hand very quickly to point at the object) Tube.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: (Points to the picture of the tube) Look at this picture.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Tube. Tube. Tube. (Repeats the word repeatedly while looking at the designated image)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: (Points to the images of the piggy bank and ball) What about these ones?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Piggy bank! (Makes a hand movement marking a '√' in the empty space above the paper)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Please look at the task sheet and find the tube shape.

STUDENT: (Moves his hand very quickly to point at the object) Tube.

TUTOR: (Points to the picture of the tube) Look at this picture.

STUDENT: Tube. Tube. Tube. (Repeats the word repeatedly while looking at the designated image)

TUTOR: (Points to the images of the piggy bank and ball) What about these ones?

STUDENT: Piggy bank! (Makes a hand movement marking a '√' in the empty space above the paper)

task.content: Identifying 'tube' shapes on a task sheet using images of concrete objects
task.learning_goal: Identify appropriate concrete objects specified geometry

context.materials: Task sheet with images of concrete objects including a tube, piggy bank, and ball, along with concrete objects that are observed
context.social_setting: Teacher guiding students working on task

challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Appears matching gesture, responded by repeating the words of teachers call 'tube' in the designated image repeatedly, calling 'piggy bank' and then hand movements mark '√' in space
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Distraction on observation so that Rico difficult perceive, analyze and establish the identity of geometric shapes

behavior_patterns.condition: If suddenly the idea/notion of the object being observed
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Immediately respond very quickly move the hand pointing object, calling the identity associated with the observed object, but this movement is accompanied by accentuation echolalia
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Echolalia break the concentration (being the trigger of distraction)
